items.title_en: James Conner - Without clear timeline for return
items.summary_en: Cardinals head coach Mike LaFleur said Wednesday that he has no new updates on the status of Conner (foot), who is still "working to return to perform," Tyler Drake of ArizonaSports.com reports. "It was not a good injury," LaFleur said.
